# David Hair Solutions

> סלון פרטי בנס ציונה המתמחה בטופרים לשיער דליל, פאות בהתאמה אישית, פאות רפואיות ויחידות שיער משיער אנושי רמי. ייעוץ ראשוני חינם וללא התחייבות.
> Private salon in Nes Ziona, Israel specializing in hair toppers for thinning hair, custom wigs, medical wigs and hair units made from human Remy hair. Free initial consultation.

## Business details
- Name: David Hair Solutions (דיוויד הייר סולושנס)
- Address: שביט 8, נס ציונה 7408028, ישראל (Shavit 8, Nes Ziona, Israel)

- Hours: Sunday–Thursday, 09:00–19:00
- Language: Hebrew

## Services
- Hair toppers (טופר שיער): partial hair units covering the crown, part line or thinning areas, clipped to existing hair. https://hairtoppersisrael.com/hair-toppers
- Toppers for thin hair (טופר לשיער דליל): https://hairtoppersisrael.com/hair-toppers-thin-hair
- Hair units (יחידות שיער / כיפת שיער): https://hairtoppersisrael.com/hair-units
- Frontal hairline pieces (פדחת): https://hairtoppersisrael.com/padachat
- Hair bands / hair pieces (צמידי שיער): https://hairtoppersisrael.com/tzamidei-sear
- Custom wigs (פאות בהתאמה אישית): https://hairtoppersisrael.com/custom-wigs
- Medical wigs (פאות רפואיות, e.g. after chemotherapy or for alopecia): https://hairtoppersisrael.com/medical-wigs
- Salon blending (גזירה ושילוב בסלון): https://hairtoppersisrael.com/salon-blending
- Wig repairs and upgrades (תיקונים ושדרוגים): https://hairtoppersisrael.com/wig-repairs-upgrades

## Prices
- Ready-made hair toppers: from ₪900
- Final price depends on hair quality, base size and level of customization. Free initial consultation, no commitment.

## Key facts
- Hair type: 100% human Remy hair, can be colored, straightened, curled and heat-styled.
- Base types: lace, silk and monofilament.
- Initial consultation takes about one hour.
- Ready-made toppers and wigs are usually fitted the same week; fully custom products take 2–4 weeks.
- A quality topper or wig typically lasts 1–2 years with proper care.
- Follow-up service: periodic salon check-ups, clip repairs, light trimming and refresh.
